ModStrings.Name: Augments Unleashed
ModStrings.AugmentsOverhualModeResetWarning: I know all my custom augments overhual will reset to default.
ModStrings.AugmentsMenuNote:
Any augments past the default amount will not show in the game's menus.
Close & open the Pause Menu to update the Status menu.

AugmentDescribtions.4: Increases the likelihood of being targeted by foes
AugmentDescribtions.6: Enables you to carry additional weight
AugmentDescribtions.7: Allows you to lift up and pin down foes longer
AugmentDescribtions.8: Hastens recovery when downed and when crawling
AugmentDescribtions.9: Increases damage dealt by your attacks when targets are not in battle stance
AugmentDescribtions.11: Causes your lantern to consume less oil and illuminate larger area
AugmentDescribtions.12: Increases damage dealt when striking a target's vitals
AugmentDescribtions.13: Enables you to clamber up cliffs and scale foes and other surfaces faster
AugmentDescribtions.15: Increases the amount of Health recovered by curatives and curative magicks
AugmentDescribtions.16: Reduces the duration of debilitations you are afflicted with
AugmentDescribtions.17: Extends the duration of enchantments and invigorations
AugmentDescribtions.19: Decreases the likelihood of being targeted by foes
AugmentDescribtions.20: Slightly restores Health when you deliver a killing blow to a foe
AugmentDescribtions.21: Reduces the Stamina consumed when struggling in a foe's grip
AugmentDescribtions.22: Reduces the Stamina consumed when clinging to or pinning down foes
AugmentDescribtions.25: Improves your ability to push and pull targets when grabbing hold
AugmentDescribtions.26: Improves your ability to break through an opponent's guard
AugmentDescribtions.28: Reduces cumulation of the loss gauge when receiving damage
AugmentDescribtions.29: Increases the likelihood of inflicting debilitations with your attacks
AugmentDescribtions.30: Reduces the rate at which items deteriorate
AugmentDescribtions.32: Increases damage dealt when exploiting a hostile target's elemental weakness
AugmentDescribtions.34: Hastens movement speed while carrying or lifting
AugmentDescribtions.35: Increases gold obtained when acquiring coin pouches
AugmentDescribtions.36: Augments your Strength during the day and your Magick at night
AugmentDescribtions.37: Increases the amount of rift crystals obtained when acquiring rift fragments and the like
AugmentDescribtions.39: Augments the physical Defense and Magick Defense of pawns in your party
AugmentDescribtions.40: Recovers Stamina when you deliver the killing blow to a target
AugmentDescribtions.41: Increases the likelihood that smaller targets will drop items
AugmentDescribtions.42: Augments the Strength and Magick of pawns in your party
AugmentDescribtions.43: Reduces the amount of time taken for fallen pawns to revive
AugmentDescribtions.44: Alerts you to the presence of any Seeker's Tokens or Wakestone shards in the vicinity with sound and blinking light
AugmentDescribtions.45: You have a chance of creating one more of the resulting product when combining materials
AugmentDescribtions.46: Decreases the likelihood of being beset by hostile targets while camping or riding in an oxcart
AugmentDescribtions.47: Decreases the likelihood that hostile targets will detect you when you are not in battle stance
AugmentDescribtions.48: Enables you to raise your affinity with people more easily
AugmentDescribtions.49: Reduces the Stamina consumed when performing a weapon skill
AugmentDescribtions.50: Reduces the amount by which weight affects your movement speed
AugmentDescribtions.51: Acquirable items dropped by foes you encounter are displayed on the minimap
AugmentDescribtions.52: You have a chance of acquiring an additional gold from treasure chests and meat from enemies
AugmentDescribtions.53: Reduces Stamina consumed by jumping and dashing while accompanying the hound
AugmentDescribtions.54: Reduces Stamina consumed by 15% when performing advanced weapon skills. Partially stacks with Zeal.
